items.name: Pip's Bell-Charm
items.lore: A little brass bell on a string. It rings on its own when water is near.

items.name: River-Stone Ring
items.lore: A smooth black pebble, drilled through and set in copper.

items.name: Reed-Woven Sash
items.lore: Goblin work, oddly fine. It smells of the river.

items.name: Fisherman's Mantle
items.lore: A heavy, patched cloak that once belonged to a man who drowned. Someone has mended it since.

items.name: Menhir-Chip Amulet
items.lore: A flake of the blood-stone, scrubbed clean and blessed three times. It still feels warm.

items.name: Osric's Scrip
items.lore: A friar's simple belt and pouch, full of salt and seeds.

items.name: Sacrificer's Sickle-Pin
items.lore: A bronze cloak pin shaped like the filidh's sickle. Melted down, it would be worth little. Worn, it is a warning.

items.name: Band of Mercy
items.lore: A plain silver ring given to novices of the healers' house.
